## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes
- [ ] If `src/` changed, `plugin/dist/cli.mjs` is rebuilt (`npm run build`) and committed
- [ ] Tests cover the change, and every value in them is made up: no real transcripts, history, usage numbers, paths or ids
- [ ] If what leaves the machine changed: the README's "What leaves your machine", `test/published.ts` and `test/published-fields.test.ts` are updated together
- [ ] The README and `docs/` say what users and contributors now need to know
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line under "Unreleased" for a change users will notice
